cards.audioText: Why is the hydraulic system important to aircraft operation?
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统为什么对航空器运行很重要？
cards.referenceText: The hydraulic system provides pressure to operate important aircraft components. Depending on the aircraft, these may include flight controls, landing gear, flaps and slats, brakes, steering, spoilers, and thrust reversers. This makes hydraulics important for aircraft control and maneuverability.
cards.referenceTextZh: 液压系统提供压力来驱动飞机的重要部件。根据机型不同，这些部件可能包括飞行操纵面、起落架、襟翼和缝翼、刹车、转向、扰流板和反推装置。因此，液压系统对飞机操纵和机动能力十分重要。

cards.audioText: How can a major hydraulic system failure affect an aircraft in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统发生重大故障会如何影响飞行中的航空器？
cards.referenceText: A major hydraulic failure may affect the flight controls, landing gear, flaps, and brakes. The crew may be unable to extend the gear or flaps, which can lead to a gear-up landing, a higher landing speed, and a longer landing distance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重液压故障可能影响飞行操纵、起落架、襟翼和刹车。机组可能无法放下起落架或襟翼，从而导致机腹着陆、更高的着陆速度和更长的着陆距离。

cards.audioText: How many independent hydraulic systems does the aircraft type you fly have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型有多少套相互独立的液压系统？
cards.referenceText: I fly the DA-40, which has one hydraulic system, mainly for the main-gear brakes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是 DA-40，它有一套液压系统，主要用于主起落架刹车。

cards.audioText: How should a flight crew respond to the failure of one hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh: 一套液压系统失效时，飞行机组应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: On the DA-40 I fly, the first priority is to maintain aircraft control, airspeed, altitude, and attitude. I would follow the checklist, advise ATC, and try to resolve the problem. If it could not be resolved, I would return or divert to a suitable airport, request a longer runway if braking were affected, and arrange a maintenance inspection after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我飞的 DA-40 上，首要任务是保持飞机控制、空速、高度和姿态。我会执行检查单、通知空中交通管制，并尝试解决问题。如果无法解决，我会返航或改航至合适机场；如果制动受到影响，会申请较长跑道，并在着陆后安排维修检查。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft systems or components are commonly powered by hydraulics?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些航空器系统或部件通常由液压驱动？
cards.referenceText: Depending on the aircraft, hydraulics may power the landing gear, nose-wheel steering, brakes, ailerons, elevators, rudder, flaps, and slats.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据机型不同，液压系统可能驱动起落架、前轮转向、刹车、副翼、升降舵、方向舵、襟翼和缝翼。

cards.audioText: Can an aircraft continue to operate safely after losing one hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh: 失去一套液压系统后，航空器能否继续安全运行？
cards.referenceText: Yes, an aircraft with more than one independent hydraulic system may continue to operate after one system fails because another working system can still provide hydraulic power.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，拥有多套独立液压系统的飞机在一套系统失效后仍可能继续运行，因为另一套正常系统仍可提供液压动力。

cards.audioText: How should a flight crew respond to a hydraulic fluid leak in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中液压油泄漏时，飞行机组应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The crew should follow the SOP and hydraulic-leak checklist, check the fluid quantity and possible leak source, and monitor aircraft control and performance. They should advise ATC and, if pressure drops significantly, divert to a suitable airport with a long runway. They should prepare for an emergency landing and evacuation if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应执行标准操作程序和液压泄漏检查单，检查液压油量和可能的泄漏源，并监控飞机操纵和性能。他们应通知空中交通管制；如果压力明显下降，应改航至跑道较长的合适机场。必要时还应准备紧急着陆和撤离。

cards.audioText: How can a hydraulic fluid leak affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 液压油泄漏会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A hydraulic fluid leak can reduce system pressure and cause partial or complete loss of flight controls, landing gear, brakes, or thrust reversers. A severe leak may make the aircraft difficult to control and can contribute to a runway overrun or structural damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 液压油泄漏会降低系统压力，并造成飞行操纵、起落架、刹车或反推部分或完全丧失。严重泄漏可能使飞机难以操纵，并可能促成冲出跑道或结构损伤。
